title: Klay Thompson Dallas Mavericks 2025-2026 NBA Tip-Off Game Worn Association Edition Jersey
description_block: This home ‘Association Edition’ jersey was worn by Klay Thompson on October 22, 2025, during the NBA Tip-Off, when the Dallas Mavericks played the San Antonio Spurs. Thompson finished with 10 points, 2 rebounds, and 1 assist. The Mavericks lost to the Spurs, 125-92.  The 2014-2015 season was a breakout year for Thompson and the Warriors. Thompson was named an All-Star and was named to the All-NBA 3rd Team, set the record for points in a quarter with 37, and helped lead the Warriors to an NBA Championship after defeating LeBron James and the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2015 NBA Finals. This was just the beginning for Thompson and the “Splash Brothers” dynasty. Thompson and the Warriors were NBA Champions again in 2017, 2018, and 2022, and achieved an all-time NBA best record of 73–9 in the 2015–2016 season. Thompson has been named an All-Star four more times (2016–2019), was named to the All-NBA 3rd Team again in 2016, and to the All-NBA Defensive 2nd Team in 2019. Thompson also cemented his place in the pantheon of NBA shooters with several red-hot shooting displays, including his win in the 2016 3-Point Shooting Contest, scoring 60 points in 29 minutes with 11 dribbles, tying the NBA record for most consecutive three-pointers made with 10, and setting the record for most three-pointers made in a game with 14. Ahead of the 2024–2025 NBA season, Thompson began the next chapter of his career, joining the Dallas Mavericks after 13 seasons with the Golden State Warriors. Bringing championship experience, elite shooting, and veteran leadership, Thompson continues to add to a legacy that has already left an indelible mark on the NBA. At the time of cataloging, Thompson has career averages of 18.7 points per game, 3.5 rebounds per game, and 2.2 assists per game. This jersey has been photomatched by Sotheby’s Photomatching.
